Distinguish deletion effects from the heat response and state the selected genotype/temperature contrast.
The repository lists 14 RNASeq samples: WT and delta-clpB at 30 and 39 degrees C each in three biological replicates, plus two delta-polA samples at 30 degrees C.
Preserve each selected sample, replicate and sequencing-file association; do not infer a delta-polA 39-degree group.
The supplied processed file contains gene counts, which require an applicable differential-expression analysis before becoming log effects and estimated variances.
Keep measured transcript responses separate from direct regulation, protein aggregation and survival phenotypes.
Preserve the published study and dataset as representations of their original experiments.
A barcoded TnSeq experiment in the same paper is not automatically a compatible genomic-junction input for the TnSeq application.
